text:
eva: pushed changes to fix the points from review, PTAL when you have a moment → https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412
Summary:
- fixed NPE in batcher init (moved nil check)
- removed duplicated logging in serve/handler.go
- added unit test for kv cache eviction + small rename

sam: thanks — will look after standup, if it's small i can do a quick pass now

liam: quick question: did you preserve the legacy fallback path? i looked at the diff and couldn't find it

eva: yes, fallback still lives in runtime/serve/fallback.go — i only refactored the batching path. added a comment pointing to it in the PR description. pushed a tiny follow-up commit.

ci-bot: CI results for branch eva/fix-batcher (build #2987): all checks passed ✅ (unit, integration, lint)

maria: left one tiny nit about the test name (makes it clearer in logs). not blocking.

eva: renamed test to `TestKVEviction_Basic` and squashed the fixup. PTAL @sam @maria

sam: LGTM — no other issues from me, approving now. :+1:

maria: approve from me too, thanks for addressing the comments.

deploy-bot: merge queued — will merge when approvals and CI status are satisfied (ETA ~1 min)

eva: thanks all. merging after deploy-bot confirms. I opened a follow-up issue for perf observation during canary: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/84

sam: noted, will add a quick alert for cache-hit-rate drop during canary.

liam: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround.

(eva edited message)
